visual_review.method: the 16 problem-statement pages reuse tools/ko_reflow/plancks/2023.html (source pages are byte-identical in text and positions; stamps remapped to TS page numbers); all 36 solution pages compared side by side with the source at 60-75 dpi, with 100-200 dpi close-ups where text meets stamps; first-line baselines measured against the source on every solution page (331 blocks, median offset +0.1 pt, all within about 1.2 pt); display equations, tables, figures, footnote rule and the reference list stamped from the source; edgecheck.py reports 0 stamps cutting ink; check.py leaves only harmless items: the 3 pre-existing problem-page artefacts (p23 side text vs figure, p40/p50 wide math boxes), Korean overlay labels deliberately placed on stamps (p14 under-brace labels, p19/p20 table headers), and line-box contacts of 2.7-5.9 pt between text blocks and neighbouring stamps or tall inline math with no visible ink overlap
